Android-x86, Bliss OS and the Chamber of Secret Forks

While at FOSDEM'26 this year, I noticed an issue that I started working towards highlighting as a series on the relationship between corporations and community driven software.

This first article goes over some of the history I have been personally involved with and how to identify what corporate strip mining does for open source projects.

Checkout the first article in this series on Substack:

https://open.substack.com/pub/electrikjesus/p/android-x86-bliss-os-and-the-chamber?r=2frikb&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web&showWelcomeOnShare=true
